algorithm: sha256((salt + "\n" + canonical_json(plan)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(), where canonical_json(obj) = json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
pair_rule: Per case, three pairs: (M1 sample 1 vs M2 sample 1), (M1 sample 2 vs M3 sample 1), (M2 sample 2 vs M3 sample 2), where M1, M2, M3 are the models in the order listed. Balance: for each pairing, the first-named model is on the left in exactly half of the cases, chosen with secrets.SystemRandom(), and on the right in the others. The order of the three pairs within a case is shuffled with secrets.SystemRandom(); pair IDs P01, P02, ... follow case order, then the shuffled pair order.
